children: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the recent rise in U.S. Treasury yields is in line with global trends and does not warrant excessive concern. According to ChainCatcher, he also praised U.S. financial intervention in Argentina and said he is open to similar aid in the future.
Bessent dismissed concerns about an AI bubble, saying companies such as Microsoft, Google, and Meta are driving significant revenue growth.

title: Bessent Says Rising U.S. Treasury Yields Track Global Trends, Backs Argentina Aid
